variables.name: STUDYID
variables.label: Study Identifier
variables.description: Unique identifier for a study.

variables.name: DOMAIN
variables.label: Domain Abbreviation
variables.description: Two-character abbreviation for the domain.

variables.name: USUBJID
variables.label: Unique Subject Identifier
variables.description: Identifier used to uniquely identify a subject across all studies for all applications or submissions involving the product.

variables.name: SPDEVID
variables.label: Sponsor Device Identifier
variables.description: Sponsor-defined identifier for a device.

variables.name: BESEQ
variables.label: Sequence Number
variables.description: Sequence number to ensure uniqueness of records within a dataset for a subject. May be any valid number (including decimals) and does not have to start at 1.

variables.name: BEGRPID
variables.label: Group ID
variables.description: Optional group identifier, used to link together a block of related records within a subject in a domain.

variables.name: BEREFID
variables.label: Reference ID
variables.description: Internal or external identifier for the specimen affected or created by the event.

variables.name: BESPID
variables.label: Sponsor-Defined Identifier
variables.description: Optional sponsor-defined reference number. Example: Line number on a CRF page.

variables.name: BETERM
variables.label: Reported Term for the Biospecimen Event
variables.description: Topic variable for an event observation, which is the verbatim or pre-specified name of the event.

variables.name: BEMODIFY
variables.label: Modified Reported Term
variables.description: If the value for BETERM is modified for coding purposes, then the modified text is placed here.

variables.name: BEDECOD
variables.label: Dictionary-Derived Term
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C124297
variables.description: Dictionary-derived text description of BETERM or BEMODIFY, if applicable.

variables.name: BECAT
variables.label: Category for Biospecimen Event
variables.description: Used to define a category of topic-variable values. Example: COLLECTION, PREPARATION, TRANSPORT.

variables.name: BESCAT
variables.label: Subcategory for Biospecimen Event
variables.description: A further categorization of BECAT values.

variables.name: BELOC
variables.label: Anatomical Location of Event
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C74456
variables.description: Describes the anatomical location relevant for the event (e.g. BRAIN, LUNG).

variables.name: BEPARTY
variables.label: Accountable Party
variables.description: Party accountable for the transferable object (e.g. specimen) as a result of the activity performed in the associated BETERM variable. The party could be an individual (e.g., subject), an organization (e.g., sponsor), or a location that is a proxy for an individual or organization (e.g., site). It is usually a somewhat general term that is further identified in the BEPRTYID variable.

variables.name: BEPRTYID
variables.label: Identification of Accountable Party
variables.description: Identification of the specific party accountable for the transferable object (e.g. Specimen) after the action in BETERM is taken. Used in conjunction with BEPARTY.

variables.name: VISITNUM
variables.label: Visit Number
variables.description: Clinical encounter number. Numeric version of VISIT, used for sorting.

variables.name: VISIT
variables.label: Visit Name
variables.description: Protocol-defined description of clinical encounter.

variables.name: VISITDY
variables.label: Planned Study Day of Visit
variables.description: Planned study day of VISIT. Should be an integer.

variables.name: BEDTC
variables.label: Date/Time of Specimen Collection
variables.description: Date and time of specimen collection.

variables.name: BESTDTC
variables.label: Start Date/Time of Biospecimen Event
variables.description: Start date/time of the event.

variables.name: BEENDTC
variables.label: End Date/Time of Biospecimen Event
variables.description: End date/time of the event.

variables.name: BESTDY
variables.label: Study Day of Start of Biospecimen Event
variables.description: Actual study day of start of observation expressed in integer days relative to the sponsor-defined RFSTDTC in Demographics.

variables.name: BEENDY
variables.label: Study Day of End of Biospecimen Event
variables.description: Actual study day of end of observation expressed in integer days relative to the sponsor-defined RFSTDTC in Demographics.

variables.name: BEDUR
variables.label: Duration of Biospecimen Event
variables.description: Collected duration and unit of a biospecimen event. Used only if collected on the CRF and not derived from start and end date/times. Example: P1DT2H (for 1 day, 2 hours).
